items.note: Re-verified against current intake.md: the lab plan runs every lab against learner-local PostgreSQL through pinned pgJDBC with jdbc:postgresql URLs and PG* environment settings, no H2 and no container; the F23 project lab keeps that PostgreSQL proof. The registered jdbc-data-access bridge pages teach exactly that connection path (jdbc:postgresql://host:port/database built from PGHOST/PGPORT/PGDATABASE, matching the pgJDBC documented URL forms) before the project lab, so the PostgreSQL-integration objective is taught and lab-validated against real PostgreSQL.
